target: USWDS publisher modal accessibility checklist and version-bound test-status limits
observed_behavior: The USWDS Modal accessibility-testing page reports 14 first-party component tests mapped to WCAG 2.1 AA: 13 Passed, zero Passed with exceptions, one Conditional, and zero Failed. It labels the headings-and-labels item conditional because clear headings and labels depend on the adopting site's content; that item and other shown checks list 'Last test: v3.8.2'. The page says USWDS tests its components in isolation, instructs adopters to retest in their own site for Section 508, and presents general, zoom, keyboard and screen-reader checklists. The main site banner separately advertises v3.13.0, so the test-status edition is not silently equated with the banner release.
context: W07 B4 K3 bounded first-party USWDS Modal reference; source sections: Modal accessibility status; Test the modal in your project; Modal accessibility checklist — General/Zoom/Keyboard/Screen reader. Explanatory DESIGN_SYSTEM / OFFICIAL_REFERENCE only; not cross-source or runtime evidence.
limitations: Publisher-reported statuses are DOCUMENTATION_STATEMENT, not TEST_RESULT executed or witnessed by this worker.
Tests are reported against WCAG 2.1 AA, not WCAG 2.2; neither global conformity nor future application-level accessibility is proven.
The publisher page's last-test v3.8.2 and the site's v3.13.0 download banner refer to different contexts; no proof of tests for the newer advertised version is inferred.
One content-dependent result is Conditional, so 'all 14 passed unconditionally' would be false.
USWDS explicitly requires each adopting site to test its implementation; no Kirion browser, keyboard, AT, zoom, orientation or color-contrast tests were run.
